name: Viviana Power Tech Ltd
tagline: SME power-T&D EPC contractor (lines/substations to 400 kV, some HVDC) with a >Rs 1,400 Cr order book and >Rs 500 Cr of BESS wins, migrating to the main board - but the (now-exited) thread author documents an auditor-flagged director fund withdrawal, a ~Rs 62 Cr unexplained advances outflow and an unrelated pivot into real estate
business_overview: Viviana Power Tech (founded 2014, NSE Emerge listed 2022, main-board migration in-principle approval May 2026) does turnkey EPC for power transmission and distribution - design, supply, erection, testing and commissioning of lines and substations up to 400 kV, plus HVDC work - for state utilities and private renewable developers. It has entered transformer manufacturing via a 75% stake in Aarsh Transformers and is spending ~Rs 100 Cr on a greenfield equipment plant, and has won >Rs 500 Cr of BESS EPC orders (RVUNL 200 MWh Rajasthan, GUVNL 130 MWh Gujarat). Sovrenn Daily News seed (2026-09-02); Sovrenn trigger: H2 FY26 sales +2.6x YoY to ~Rs 441 Cr, net profit +2.9x YoY to ~Rs 44 Cr.
fundamentals_table: H2 FY26 sales +2.6x YoY (~Rs 441 Cr), PAT +2.9x YoY (~Rs 44 Cr); HoH sales +4.8x - a very steep, sudden ramp
>Rs 1,400 Cr; BESS orders >Rs 500 Cr; ~Rs 100 Cr greenfield transformer capex
Auditors flagged directors withdrawing ~Rs 6.37 Cr for personal use (debit balance); company calls it cheque-clearing timing differences (thread author sceptical)
Short-Term Loans & Advances up 1843% (Rs 3.39 Cr -> Rs 65.83 Cr) in H1 FY26 - a ~Rs 62 Cr outflow vs ~Rs 6.9 Cr H1 net profit, funded by rising debt
~14% of FY25 and ~21% of H1 FY26 consolidated revenue is real estate (Viviana Life Spaces flat sales); MoA object clause formally amended to include real-estate development
fundamentals_narrative: On the surface a well-placed small-cap plugged into India's T&D and BESS capex, with a >Rs 1,400 Cr order book, marquee BESS wins and a main-board move. But the thread author (r8b8), who has since exited, documents three governance issues that dominate the read: (1) auditors flagged directors withdrawing ~Rs 6.37 Cr for personal use, explained away as cheque-timing; (2) short-term loans & advances jumped ~1843% (a ~Rs 62 Cr cash outflow that dwarfs H1 profit, funded by debt); and (3) an unrelated diversification into real estate now ~21% of consolidated revenue, formalised via an MoA amendment. Combined with a suspiciously steep H2 FY26 ramp (sales +2.6x YoY), this is a caution case regardless of the order book.
technical_read: Not pulled. SME-to-mainboard transition; promotional recent posts.

Author r8b8 wrote the initiation and the peer comparison, then posted 'Exited the stock, found some red flags' (Dec 2025) followed by a detailed red-flags post (Jan 2026, 5 love): real-estate revenue creep + MoA amendment, auditor-flagged director withdrawals, and the ~Rs 62 Cr advances outflow funded by debt. Later posts (rohitahuja, Vivek_Chadha) are promotional main-board-migration notes with no engagement on the governance points.

MoA object clause amended to add real-estate development. Main-board migration in-principle approval received May 2026.

verdict_headline: HIGH CAUTION: auditor-flagged director withdrawals + a ~Rs 62 Cr unexplained advances outflow funded by debt + an unrelated real-estate pivot - documented by the (now-exited) thread author - override a genuine T&D/BESS order book. thesis_fit neither, conviction Low.
